content.title: About
content.content: The chicken fillet sandwich is a fast‑food item featuring a tender chicken breast, either grilled or fried, placed between a soft bun and often complemented with lettuce, sauce, and cheese.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The chicken fillet is usually skinless, making it less fatty than many other fast‑food meats.
The grilled version is considered healthier because it requires little to no oil.
Chicken fillet sandwiches are commonly served in combo meals with fries and a drink.
Some regions add spices such as paprika or garlic to boost the fillet’s flavor.
Chicken breast is a good source of protein, B‑vitamins, and selenium.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken breast provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low fat (grilled)
items.content: Grilling uses minimal added fat, making the sandwich a lighter option.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6 and B12 support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of selenium
items.content: Selenium acts as an antioxidant, helping protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The combination of protein and carbohydrates in the bun helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Sauces and seasonings can add a lot of salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Fat in fried version
items.content: Deep‑frying increases calories and may introduce trans fats.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Undercooked fillet can harbor salmonella; internal temperature should reach 75 °C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is typically eaten by hand, sometimes split in half. It can be customized with fresh vegetables, mustard, mayo, or a yogurt‑based sauce. For a lighter choice, opt for grilled fillet and a whole‑grain bun.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best consumed immediately. If you need to store it, wrap tightly in plastic film and keep refrigerated for no more than 24 hours. For longer storage, keep the chicken fillet separate in an airtight container at 0‑4 °C.
